q: The generating function approach to canonical transformations uses a function S(q,P) such that the old and new canonical coordinates are related by:
exp: For a generating function of type-2, S(q,P): old momenta p = ∂S/∂q and new coordinates Q = ∂S/∂P. The transformation is canonical (symplectic) iff these relations hold, and the new Hamiltonian is K(Q,P) = H(q(Q,P),p(Q,P)) + ∂S/∂t.
